description: ol-reserved-word (issue #427, M4 audit): `define axes ... end` redefines `axes`, a Geometry overlay primitive (spec/geometry-module.md's `## axes`). The static checker flags the procedure name at its own span. SCOPE, CORRECTED: this used to say the verdict is "gated on the active `geometry` profile", which describes shipped behaviour rather than the rule. `spec/grammar.md:408` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names UNCONDITIONALLY -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- so a conforming 0.4.0 implementation raises here with or without `geometry` claimed, and this fixture's ACTIVE-profile assertion is correct for both readings. The Core-only direction is pinned separately by geometry/check/reserved-word-not-gated-without-geometry, which asserted the shipped gate until issue #841 retired it and now raises here too. Issue #838 dropped the `namespace: "primitive"` param (spec/error-model.md:125). The overlays are the deliberate counterpoint to `geometry/check/stdlib-names-are-definable`: `grid`/`axes`/`measure` are renderer-backed PRIMITIVES and so are built-in names, while `polygon`/`circle`/`arc`/`star`/`area`/`perimeter` are OpenLogo source and stay free to define (spec/grammar.md:412).
